quotes.text: ENVIRONMENT CONSULTANT P a g e | 5 TURKEL SAND QUARRY-2 AT TEL RIVER M/S GREEN CIRCLE INC. NABET/EIA/2124/RA 0219 Baseline study of the study area was conducted during pre-monsoon from 1st October 2021 to 31st December 2021 for Turkel Sand quarry-2. The concentrations of PM10 and PM2.5 for all the 8 AAQM stations were found between 52.30 to 73.8 µg/m3 and 16.70 to 23.60 µg/m3 respectively. The concentrations of SO2 and NOx were found to be in range of range of 6.4 to 9.1µg/m3 and 9.7 to 13.60 µg/m3 respectively. Ambient noise levels were measured at 8 locations around the Mine site. Noise levels varied from 42.1dB (A) Leq to 44
